name: Egypt
contextBlurb: Egypt does not provide an open stablecoin regime. Crypto issuance, trading, promotion and platform operation require Central Bank approval, and private stablecoin payment activity is effectively restricted.

stablecoinMeta.summaryEn: Egypt does not provide an open stablecoin regime. Crypto issuance, trading, promotion and platform operation require Central Bank approval, and private stablecoin payment activity is effectively restricted.
stablecoinMeta.classificationNote: Stablecoins are not separately defined and are treated within the broader cryptocurrency restriction.

regulators.name: Central Bank of Egypt
regulators.role: Central bank and licensing authority for payment, banking and crypto-related activity.
